vulnerable_statements.reason: byt_rt5640_quirk can be set to an arbitrary value through the quirk_override module parameter (or DMI driver_data), and BYT_RT5640_MAP() extracts a multi-bit field that can exceed 4. map_name has only 5 entries, and nothing checks the index before using it, so the read can go past the end of the array. The out-of-bounds pointer is then passed to snprintf as a string.
This is the same unchecked index into the 5-entry map_name array, used here to build the card long_name. It can also read out of bounds and dereference an invalid string pointer.

suggested_fix: Check BYT_RT5640_MAP(byt_rt5640_quirk) against ARRAY_SIZE(map_name) before using it. If it is out of range, reject the quirk with an error, or fall back to a safe default such as "none"/BYT_RT5640_DMIC1_MAP and log a warning. Better still, check the quirk_override value when it is applied, so an invalid map field never reaches the code that formats the strings.
